sermon.title: Blackguard Balaam
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Continuing on the first commandment, Pastor David G. Kincer studies Balaam, the sorcerer hired to curse Israel. God turned the curse into blessing and spoke truth through him, but Balaam’s counsel led Israel into immorality and idolatry. Jesus warned Pergamos about the doctrine of Balaam. The lesson: take counsel from God’s word, and God works through his people, whom he never abandons.

faqs.question: Is the Bible a book of faith?
faqs.answer: He says it is a book of truth; faith comes from the word.

faqs.question: Who is the Prophet of Deuteronomy 18:18?
Whom did Moab fear?
faqs.answer: The people of God, not just Moses.

faqs.question: Does God using someone make that person acceptable?
faqs.answer: No—the power is in the word, not the speaker.

faqs.question: Is being an elder a title?
faqs.answer: No—it’s a job description; get to work.

faqs.question: Can a tithe be a bribe?
faqs.answer: Yes—for a preacher to flatter you with what you want to hear.

faqs.question: What was Balaam’s counsel?
faqs.answer: To lead Israel into immorality and idolatry so God would judge them.

faqs.question: Can sorcery curse God’s people?
faqs.answer: No—it has no effect on the people of God.

faqs.question: Does God leave his people when they fail?
faqs.answer: No—he stays with them to save and correct them.
